provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Ranch

voice_persona.name: 见过旱年的牧场账房先生
voice_persona.description: 一位既在门廊上喝过咖啡也算过干草账的解说者：尊重浪漫（不嘲讽牛仔梦），但每一页浪漫都要配上账页；语气像一个愿意把难看数字摊开给你看的行业前辈——数据必带基准来源（USDA/联储/州推广站），演算必让观众能复算，宣判必短
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作认真的准买家：用 you 代入其幻想与决策，用专家的引述与协会的基准代替个人观点
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自官方基准（USDA/ERS/联储）、推广站专家引述、可复算的完整账本与明确标注的年份语境

tone_profile.certainty_style: 基准数据直接给并注来源年份；演算数字标明假设（call it 90%式）；情景推演声明非最好非最坏；对浪漫保持尊重

rhythm_rules.rule: 概念→基准数字→演算→宣判四拍，宣判多为短句（Revenue arrives seasonally. Expenses arrive daily.）
层叠列举（围栏/水/设施/仓储）每项一个数字，最后总账定性
rhythm_rules.function: 把隐性成本加到观众心理上

rhythm_rules.rule: 演算逐步报数并标明假设（Let's use 2,400 as a working number / call it 90%）
rhythm_rules.function: 让观众复算并理解假设的脆弱

rhythm_rules.rule: 数字密集段之间插入案例与意象（龟裂黏土/门廊日出）调节
rhythm_rules.function: 防止数字疲劳并保持田园质感

rhythm_rules.rule: 对偶与排比收束段落（牛付账/地造富；不会归零/没有差季度）
rhythm_rules.function: 把机制压缩成可复述的金句

pause_and_emphasis: 关键数字前用'Let that land for a moment'式停顿令
反转前用'Now, here is where it gets dangerous'式预警
假设提醒用'None of those things are guaranteed'式回马枪
transition_style: 陷阱预告（here is the trap that gets a lot of new buyers）
账本召唤（Let's build a real scenario. Not a worst case and not a best case.）
词义拆解开场（we need to talk about what a ranch actually is）
悖论设问（If ranching is so marginal, why do the wealthiest keep buying?）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：资产拟人化（会呼吸的库存）与便宜地反语各一两处，风险与案例段不用
placement_rules: 活资产风险的动词排比冷幽默
avoid_rules: 不嘲笑破产或受灾的经营者
不在干旱/案例段开玩笑

language_patterns.formula: That's what movies sell you. That's what the listing photos are designed to make you feel.
language_patterns.purpose: 点破梦幻画面的商业来源

language_patterns.formula: Here's what the listing doesn't show you. The [坏掉的东西], the [$账单], the [同周的坏消息] ...
language_patterns.purpose: 用隐藏现实清单对抗梦幻蒙太奇

language_patterns.formula: Revenue arrives seasonally. Expenses arrive daily.
language_patterns.purpose: 用时间副词对仗给出结构病

language_patterns.formula: The price of the X and the profitability of the X are two completely different numbers.
What you actually own is a very expensive piece of dirt with a for sale sign removed from it.
language_patterns.purpose: 在产权交割的心理高点给冷峻重定义

language_patterns.formula: unlike a warehouse, your inventory breathes, eats, gets sick, dies, escapes ...
language_patterns.purpose: 用动词排比讲透活资产风险

language_patterns.formula: A savings account at a credit union pays more. This is the dirty secret of [行业].
language_patterns.purpose: 用日常对照物落锤ROI并命名行业秘密

language_patterns.formula: What the [市场] gives you in a good year, a [灾害] takes back over the following N years.
language_patterns.purpose: 定义周期性风险的时间结构

language_patterns.formula: The [表面业务] are not the business. The [真实功能] is the business.
language_patterns.purpose: 揭穿经营表象背后的真实逻辑

language_patterns.formula: The [经营活动] pay for the privilege of owning the [资产]. The [资产] builds the wealth.
language_patterns.purpose: 用分工句概括双资产财富机制

language_patterns.formula: The romance of the X is real. The economics of the X are complicated. The people who thrive hold both truths.
language_patterns.purpose: 结尾不选边，要求观众同时持有浪漫与账本

preferred_traits: 官方基准与来源标注（USDA、Economic Research Service、Federal Reserve Bank、Extension Specialist）
单位化数字（per acre、per cow、per hundredweight、per bale）
行业术语通俗并用（bred female、hundredweight、conservation easement、H-2A）
假设标记词（call it、let's say、working number、roughly）

forbidden_style.rule: 基准数据必须注明来源与年份
税务机制注明法域且不构成税务建议
不嘲笑受灾或破产的经营者；浪漫不被否定，只被配对账本
禁止编造数据、行情或法规细节
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
